iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 45. US-Israel systematically destroying nuclear expertise (CNN, JINSA). Iran proposes 'workable' 10-point peace plan requiring enrichment acceptance + sanction relief. Trump pulls back threats for 2-week ceasefire window. Iranian negotiators heading to Islamabad for talks. 440kg 60% HEU still trapped at Isfahan. IAEA still withdrawn. Diplomatic: MEDIUM (improved from LOW). Technical: CRITICAL. Probability DOWN to 42%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 45. Strait of Hormuz 'virtually shut' despite ceasefire (Times of Israel). IRGC released mine navigation maps. Iran FM says passage allowed for 2 weeks under Iranian military management. Iranian media claims strait 'closed again' — oil tanker turned away. Euronews: 'ceasefire threatened as Iran closes strait again'. Trump pulls back on widening attacks. Iranian negotiators heading to Islamabad. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability DOWN to 30%. Falling.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 45. ⚠️ ESCALATION ACCELERATING: April 8 attacks killed 254+ people, 1000+ wounded — deadliest single day (Democracy Now). Israel explicitly REJECTED ceasefire for Lebanon. Netanyahu: 'ceasefire with Iran will not include Hezbollah'. Hezbollah RESUMED rocket fire Apr 9 on northern Israel. '10 Minutes, 100 Airstrikes' — Israel's most intense bombing wave. 1.1 million displaced. UK/France calling for ceasefire. Trump backs Israel, calls Lebanon 'separate skirmish'. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 68%. RISING. Most volatile zone.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: NATO Steadfast Dart-2026 exercise underway. Patriot battery deployed to Malatya. Roketsan planning 2026 test of 300 ER air-launched ballistic missile. FM Fidan nuclear arms race comments continue. OSW analysis: Turkey pursuing strategic ambiguity on nuclear weapons. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: ESCALATORY RHETORIC: Pakistan Defence Minister Asif warns 'space for war between two nuclear states is inconceivable' — sharp nuclear signaling against India. CFR think tank rates renewed India-Pakistan conflict as Tier II contingency (moderate risk). Pahalgam anniversary approaching — potential trigger event. India rejects US mediation claims. Rhetoric: HIGH (up from medium). Probability UP slightly to 18%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: BREAKING UPDATE: Trump-Rutte meeting confirmed — NATO HOLDS. Russia approaching 2026 NPT Review with 'significant disagreements'. Medvedev threatening nuclear weapons against Ukraine and supplier countries. Iran war is 'strategic windfall' for Russia per multiple analyses — surging oil prices, diverted Western attention, strained NATO. Strategic Rocket Forces at 90% modernization. Lavrov nuclear rhetoric continues. Stable at 58%.

china.name: China
china.notes: DPP promoting $40B drone procurement budget (200,000 unmanned systems). KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun completed Beijing visit — cross-strait proxy dynamics. CNN investigation: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure confirmed. Taiwan military warns budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons buying + F-16 training. ISW update Apr 3. Taiwan Warns of China's Hybrid Tactics (Apr 8). Technical: CRITICAL. Stable at 11%.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: THIRD missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8) — multiple SRBMs from Wonsan area, 240km each. VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea 'most hostile enemy state', called them 'world-startling fools'. Kim observed cruise missile test from new destroyer. Constitutional nuclear status 'irreversible'. Kim demands US nuclear recognition. 38 North: solid-propellant ICBM (Hwasong-18), tactical nukes, LACMs all probably deployed. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability UP slightly to 88%.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Arms Control Association: Russia concocting 'Ukrainian bomb' claims — potential pretext for nuclear escalation. New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. Full arms race underway per Bulletin. ISW daily assessments show continued Russian offensive operations. Carnegie analysis: Russia faces hostile countries from Kola Peninsula to Black Sea. Nuclear threats from Medvedev continue. Stable at 82%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC BREAKTHROUGH SUSTAINED: China-hosted Urumqi talks concluded. New round of ceasefire talks underway per Al Jazeera. Pakistan-Afghanistan agreed to 'avoid any escalation' and 'explore comprehensive solution'. Bloomberg/Reuters: both sides committed to resolving differences. VP Vance delegation (incl. Kushner) heading to Islamabad this weekend — US diplomatic engagement increasing. China 'actively mediating' per FM spokesperson. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 8%. Falling.
